assertions: Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix

expectations.text: Connects to the v3 streaming endpoint (streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws), not the v2 realtime URL
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:17 sets ENDPOINT = "wss://streaming.assemblyai.com/v3/ws"; lines 118–119 connect to it.

expectations.text: Sets the streaming model explicitly to universal-3-6-pro (universal-3-5-pro also acceptable); not u3-rt-pro or an older model
Enables redact_pii, with policies that cover person names, phone numbers and SSNs (or the default, which is all)
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:34–35 enables redact_pii and supplies PII_POLICIES; line 21 includes "person_name", "phone_number", and "us_social_security_number".

expectations.text: Sends audio at real-time pace in small chunks
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:44 sets 100 ms chunks; lines 104–109 read chunks and pace transmission using elapsed time and sent_frames / 16000.

expectations.text: Sends Terminate and waits for Termination before exiting
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:110 sends {"type":"Terminate"}; lines 146–150 return results only after receiving Termination and awaiting the sender.

expectations.text: Does not use word_boost, boost_param or v2-era parameters such as end_utterance_silence_threshold
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:27–41 defines the connection parameters without word_boost, boost_param, or end_utterance_silence_threshold.

expectations.text: Authenticates with the raw API key or a temporary token, not a Bearer prefix
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:120 sets additional_headers={"Authorization": api_key, ...}; line 195 reads the key from ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY without adding a prefix.
